address: Via Crociata 9, Piove di Sacco, 35028, Italy
bio: In this restaurant, husband Francesco takes care of the wine, while his wife Serena is at the helm in the open-view kitchen, creating dishes with a focus on fish and seafood (including raw options), fresh pasta dishes and classic recipes with the occasional imaginative twist or the addition of exotic fruit. This is a modern and welcoming osteria with a simple decor, where the female staff provide excellent service with a friendly smile....
